sources.clean:
Plants of the World Online account: Quercus × avellaniformis Colmeiro & E.Boutelou.

The native range of this hybrid is W. Medit. It is a tree and grows primarily in the subtropical biome. The hybrid formula is Q. rotundifolia × Q. suber.
